responsibility: Defines the higher-level generic channel-device wrapper that sits between ISO IOChan operations and device-specific RTgenif callbacks. It introduces ChanDev and device kind classifications, constructors and teardown, predicates controlling EOF behavior in Look and Skip, generic text/raw read-write and look/skip procedures, and errno-to-ISO exception checking, making it the shared policy layer for file, terminal, standard-channel, and similar devices.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the interface for RTgen: it declares the opaque ChanDev type, DeviceType classification, and the exported generic channel operations and error checks. Its paired RTgen.mod file provides the actual ChanDev record layout and implements the validation, flag checking, read/write policy, and exception behavior behind those declarations.
